title: The Summer of Port Alder
author: August Pemberton
blurb: Dominic Kavanagh, a vineyard owner who inherited debts instead of grapes, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. Then the anonymous pen-pal assignment pairs enemies instead of strangers — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must forgive the person in the mirror first, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
